$comment: Phase 4 recall probe: an expense-tracker project's memory (with distractors) and 20 questions a later session would ask. A probe passes when its expected item ranks in the top 5.

items.title: Refunds do not reopen a billing period
items.body: Decision: a refund is posted to the current open period; a closed billing period stays closed. Context: reopening a period and recomputing breaks statements customers already exported. Decided by: user.

items.title: Postgres, not SQLite, for the ledger database
items.body: Decision: the ledger lives in Postgres. Rejected: SQLite, which hit database-locked errors under the load test with the worker writing concurrently. Decided by: user.

items.title: No axios: HTTP calls use the built-in fetch
items.body: Decision: every HTTP request uses the platform fetch. Do not add axios or any other HTTP client library. Context: bundle size and one fewer dependency to audit. Decided by: user.

items.title: Receipt files go straight to S3 with presigned URLs
items.body: Decision: the browser uploads receipt images and PDFs directly to S3 using a presigned URL from the API. Files never pass through the API server. Decided by: user.

items.title: Money is stored as integer cents
items.body: Decision: every money amount is an integer number of cents; never use floating point for amounts, totals or sums. Decided by: user.

items.title: Write the drop zone by hand; no react-dropzone
items.body: Decision: the file drop area for uploads is written by hand with the native drag-and-drop events. Rejected: adding react-dropzone (12kb). Decided by: user.

items.title: Auth uses httpOnly session cookies, not JWTs in localStorage
items.body: Decision: login creates a server session referenced by an httpOnly cookie; logout and session expiry are handled server side. Rejected: JWT in localStorage (XSS exposure). Decided by: user.

items.title: Store dates in UTC; convert to the user's timezone only when displaying
items.body: Decision: timestamps are stored in UTC and converted to the viewer's timezone at the edge, in the UI. Decided by: user.

items.title: Vitest, not Jest, for unit tests
items.body: Decision: unit tests run on Vitest. Rejected: Jest, which needed a separate TypeScript transform. Decided by: user.

items.title: Feature flags live in config/flags.json
items.body: Decision: features that roll out to beta users first are switched with flags in config/flags.json, not environment variables. Decided by: user.

items.title: Stay on Tailwind 3
items.body: Decision: reverted the Tailwind 4 alpha because the plugin API changed; stay on Tailwind 3 for now. Decided by: user.

items.title: The development API server listens on port 4000
items.body: npm run dev starts the API on http://localhost:4000 and the web app on port 5173.

items.title: Monthly statements are generated on the 1st by the cron worker
items.body: The worker's cron job exports each customer's billing statement as a PDF on the 1st of every month.

items.title: Web only: mobile apps are out of scope
items.body: No native mobile app (iOS or Android) is planned; the web app is responsive instead.

items.title: npm run db:seed creates local test users
items.body: The seed script creates three users (alice, bob, carol) with sample expenses for local development.

items.title: Only EUR and USD currencies are supported
items.body: Supported currencies are EUR and USD. Other currencies such as GBP or JPY are not supported yet.

items.title: Brand assets are in public/brand
items.body: Logo SVGs and favicons live in public/brand.

items.title: Staging runs on Fly.io
items.body: The staging environment is deployed to Fly.io from the main branch.

items.title: ESLint extends typescript-eslint recommended
items.body: Lint config extends @typescript-eslint/recommended with no-floating-promises on.

items.title: Transactional email is sent through Postmark
items.body: Password resets and statement notifications are sent with Postmark templates.

items.title: npm ci: use `npm ci --fetch-retries 5`
items.body: On this machine `npm ci` failed (ETIMEDOUT, network timing out behind the proxy); `npm ci --fetch-retries 5` worked instead.

items.title: npx playwright: use `npx playwright install chromium`
items.body: On this machine installing every Playwright browser failed (not enough disk space); installing only chromium for end-to-end tests worked.

items.title: docker-compose: use `docker compose`
items.body: On this machine `docker-compose up` failed (command not found); `docker compose up` worked instead.

items.title: prisma migrate: add --skip-seed
items.body: `npx prisma migrate dev` hung waiting on the seed; `npx prisma migrate dev --skip-seed` worked.

items.title: Small functions with early returns
items.body: Prefer small functions and early returns over deep nesting.

items.title: Named exports only
items.body: Use named exports; no default exports.

items.title: Imperative commit messages
items.body: Write commit messages in the imperative mood.

items.title: Build login and signup with session cookies
items.body: Outcome: done. Auth pages, session middleware and tests are finished and verified.

items.title: Receipt upload: S3 presign endpoint and client uploader
items.body: Outcome: blocked. The S3 presign endpoint works and is tested; the client uploader is half built and does not upload yet. Open: add react-dropzone or write the drop zone by hand?

items.title: Fix the failing billing.spec.ts test
items.body: Outcome: blocked. One test in billing.spec.ts still fails because it needs a human decision on whether a refund reopens the billing period.

items.title: Add CSV export for expenses
items.body: Outcome: done. Users can export their expenses as a CSV file from the list page; verified in the browser.

items.title: Dark mode for the dashboard
items.body: Outcome: done. Dashboard colors follow the system theme.

items.title: Speed up the expense list
items.body: Outcome: done. Paginated the list and added an index on expenses(user_id, created_at).

items.title: Translate the UI to German
items.body: Outcome: failed. Stopped: the translation library conflicted with the router; left for later.

items.title: Monthly spending chart
items.body: Outcome: done. A bar chart of spending per category per month on the dashboard.
